scorer: Operator adjudication (Claude Opus 5.5) of scorers A and B before unblinding; img04, img13 and img30 viewed directly. Scorers agree on all 35 no-form-figure labels.

scores.notes: Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Watercolor: large white cloud over the tabernacle (upper centre) holds only a red-orange flame; Israelites at tent doors and linen-clad priests by the court gate. Painted to all four borders, no figure in the cloud, no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Oil: white cloud/radiance above the far end of the path (top centre) holds only a flame; Moses with staff leads families carrying bundles between curling dark water walls. Full bleed, no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Oil: inside the summit smoke (upper centre) a luminous standing human figure with head, robe and outstretched arms is painted in the light — a God figure. Otherwise Moses and the crowd below match; full bleed, no text.
Operator viewed: pale sky and hillsides reach all four edges; no bare-paper border. Full.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Icon-style gold-ground: Samaritan kneels tending the wounded man propped on a rock, wine flask on rock, linen strips and jar on the ground, donkey left. Painting reaches all borders with no frame; no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Oil: in the smoke above the summit (upper centre) a veiled, ghostly robed figure with a head shape stands over the flame — a human silhouette for God. Moses and Israelites below match; full bleed, no text.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Watercolor: Samaritan kneels pouring from a flask and holding linen over the half-raised bruised man; saddled donkey with loose reins at right. Pale sky and rocks are painted to all edges; no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Watercolor: the bottom border and both lower corners fade into bare white paper below a ragged wash edge, and the lower right side edge shows unpainted paper. Content is fine: Moses and Aaron with tally board, father lifting a child, fire-glow only at the tabernacle.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Icon-style gold interior: cloud and veil at the far end (centre) contain only a flame; a patterned light-train spreads over the floor toward Isaiah. Winged figures on the walls are decorative panels; full bleed, no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Watercolor: cloud column over the camp (upper right of centre) holds a heart-shaped flame, no figure; Moses gestures among crouching Israelites gathering white flakes. Painted to all borders; no lettering.
Scorers split: B reads the tabernacle as burning under black smoke (misreading the glory cloud), A accepted it. Adjudicated uncertain without direct view.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Oil: Moses writes on a tablet beside Aaron in priestly vest, father holds a child, Levite men carry poles; light beams and flame above the tabernacle with no figure. Ornament on the tabernacle front is scrollwork, not lettering; full bleed.
Operator viewed: the blue sky wash runs to the right edge; the paler upper-right is sky, not a margin. Full.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Icon style: dark cloud above pours fire-light into the tabernacle (centre); figures on the curtains are woven cherub designs, and priests in linen stand at the gate. Gold ground reaches every edge; no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Watercolor: billowing coloured cloud and white fire rise from the tabernacle (centre-right), with no figure in the smoke; linen-clad priests at the gate and Israelites at tent doors. Full bleed, no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Watercolor: inside the bright cloud (top centre) a hooded, robed standing figure with arms hovers above the flame — a God figure. Moses leads the column between the water walls; full bleed, no text.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Watercolor: smoking, shaking summit with fire and flying rocks (top centre), no figure in the smoke; Moses in the right foreground before the gathered people. Painted to all borders; no lettering.

Scorers agree on the verdict; field difference resolved to scorer B. B: Icon style: three child-sized figures at bottom centre and right have full adult beards, which is incoherent. The cloud holds only a flame; Aaron writes on a blank tablet beside Moses; gold ground reaches the edges.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Oil: Samaritan kneels pouring from a flask onto the reclining wounded man; donkey with loose reins at right, flask and linen strips on the road. Full bleed, no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Icon style: in the ring of smoke above the summit (top centre) a veiled figure with a visible bearded face and shoulders sits above the flame — a God figure. Moses and the people below; full bleed, no text.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Oil: glowing cloud (top centre) holds only a flame; Moses with staff and families carrying bundles walk between dark water walls. Full bleed, no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Oil: Moses writes on a tablet beside Aaron in his breastpiece, a father holds up a child with his family; smoke column and flame over the tabernacle with no figure, Sinai behind. Full bleed, no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Watercolor: Moses in the foreground (centre-right) holds two separate staffs, one in each hand, a contradictory object state. The summit holds only smoke and light with no figure; full bleed, no text.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Oil: bright cloud and light beam descend into the tabernacle with fire inside (centre), no figure; priests in linen at the entrance and Israelites at tent doors. Full bleed, no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Oil: overcast sky with a bright cloud centre (top centre), no figure, and fire glows in the tabernacle; Moses gestures to kneeling women and children among scattered white flakes. Full bleed, no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Watercolor: the glowing train rises from the floor into a standing veiled cone with a rounded, head-like top under the fire cloud (centre), forming a veiled human silhouette for God. The lace pattern on the train is ornament, not lettering; full bleed.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Oil: Samaritan kneels pouring from a flask on the seated wounded man's shoulder; donkey at right, linen strips and a jar on the ground. Full bleed, no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Oil: typed captions 'What is it?' and 'It is manna.' (twice) are overlaid at mid-height, left of and right of Moses. The cloud above holds only a light/flame glow, with no figure; full bleed.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Watercolor: two near-identical white-bearded elders in dark cloaks with staffs walk in the column (left-centre and centre), reading as a duplicated Moses. The sky orb holds only a flame; full bleed, no text.
Operator viewed: the pale cream sky runs off the top and sides as a continuous wash; no paper boundary. Full (borderline).

Scorers agree on the verdict; field difference resolved to scorer B. B: Icon style: a light beam from the dark clouds (top centre) holds only a flame; Moses leads the people between stepped water walls. Gold sky and water reach all borders; no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Icon style: a raised gilt frame is painted around all four sides of the scene. Content is fine: the stylised cloud (top centre) holds only a flame, Moses points to the white flakes, and there is no lettering.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Watercolor: in the bright doorway behind the cloud (upper centre) a pale robed human figure with head and outstretched hands stands — a God figure. Isaiah in the foreground with prostrate priests; full bleed, no text.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Oil: smoke cloud at the far end of the hall (centre) holds only a flame on a bowl, with no figure; Isaiah gazes upward while priests prostrate. The requested robe-like train across the floor is missing; full bleed, no text.

Both independent scorers agree on every field. B: Oil: in the light at the right of centre stands a tall veiled, robed human figure of light with head, shoulders and folded arms, its robe flowing down as the train. Isaiah in the left foreground; full bleed, no text.
